d: For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

d: Group Human Resources Director | Retail & GCC
A leading and fast-growing retail group is seeking an experienced Group Human Resources Director to lead the next stage of its people and organizational transformation.
The group employs 2,000+ people across multiple business units, with operations in Kuwait and other GCC markets.

This is a senior leadership role with direct access to the CEO and executive management. The successful candidate will have broad ownership of the people agenda, with the mandate to strengthen the HR operating model, improve organizational effectiveness and redefine how HR supports business performance and growth.
Lead the overall HR strategy and function across talent acquisition, HR operations, compensation and benefits, performance management, employee relations, organizational development and learning.
Partner with the CEO and executive leadership on organizational structure, leadership capability, workforce strategy and business growth.
Strengthen organizational design, job architecture, grading, salary structures and compensation frameworks.
Improve manpower planning, budgeting and workforce productivity across business units and GCC operations.
Upgrade the performance management and appraisal process to create meaningful differentiation, accountability and stronger linkage between individual performance and business results.
Strengthen senior leadership hiring, succession planning and internal leadership pipelines.
Improve the quality, speed and effectiveness of recruitment across the organization.
Develop practical retention strategies for Kuwait and GCC markets, particularly for critical and high-performing talent.
Ensure effective governance of multinational payroll, HR reporting and employment compliance.
Strengthen the use of HR systems, analytics and workforce data to support better management decisions.
Build a capable HR leadership team and ensure that the function operates with appropriate accountability, service levels and business orientation.
Lead major HR transformation and change initiatives while ensuring that processes remain practical, efficient and appropriate for a fast-moving business.
15+ years of progressive HR experience, including significant leadership responsibility at Director, Senior Director, Head of HR or equivalent level.
Proven ownership of a broad, end-to-end HR function in a sizeable and complex organization.
Strong experience in retail, consumer, FMCG, hospitality or another large frontline-workforce environment.
Experience supporting or leading HR for a workforce of approximately 2,000 employees or more.
Demonstrated success in HR transformation, organizational design, manpower planning, performance management and workforce productivity.
Strong experience recruiting senior leaders through direct sourcing, market mapping, headhunting or executive search.
Experience managing HR across multiple GCC markets is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of Kuwait and GCC employment practices.
Commercial mindset with the ability to balance HR governance with business speed and operational requirements.
Direct exposure to the CEO and executive leadership.
Genuine authority to shape the people strategy and HR operating model.
Broad GCC scope across multiple businesses.
Opportunity to lead meaningful organizational transformation rather than simply maintain existing HR processes.
A highly visible role where HR initiatives will directly influence growth, productivity, leadership capability and organizational performance.
